definitions.explanation: A curved or bent piece of metal or plastic used for hanging, catching, or holding things. Used for wall hooks, coat hooks, fishing hooks, and similar items.
A short, swinging punch delivered with a bent arm in boxing or martial arts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧フック⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I attached a hook to the wall.

examples.japanese: ⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧フック⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{掛|か}けて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please hang your coat on the hook.
I put bait on the fishing hook and cast it into the river.

examples.japanese: ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧フック⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{倒|たお}した→倒す：01954_taosu⟧。
examples.english: He knocked down his opponent with a left hook.

ボディー⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{強烈|きょうれつ}→強烈：15109_kyouretsu⟧なフック⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: A powerful hook to the body landed.

notes:
From English "hook." Used in multiple everyday contexts: home organization (wall hooks, adhesive hooks), fishing, and combat sports.

In home improvement and organization, ⟦{粘着|ねんちゃく}→粘着：15074_nenchaku⟧フック (adhesive hooks) and S⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧フック (S-hooks) are common household items sold at 100-yen shops.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- フック⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{掛|か}ける: to hang on a hook
- {壁掛|かべか}けフック: wall hook
- S⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧フック: S-hook
- ⟦{左|ひだり}→左：00628_hidari⟧フック: left hook (boxing)
- {右|みぎ}フック: right hook (boxing)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鉤|かぎ}: hook; clasp — the native Japanese word, used more in traditional or technical contexts
- ⟦ハンガー→ハンガー：08275_hangaa⟧: hanger — specifically for hanging clothes
- ⟦{釣|つ}り{針|ばり}→釣り針：28211_tsuribari⟧: fishhook — the traditional Japanese term for a fishing hook
